title: Open Institutional AI Readiness Framework (OIARF)
name: OIARF
regulatoryTrack: EU AI Act Article 4 — human competence and oversight
mission: The Open Institutional AI Readiness Framework (OIARF) is an open-methodology, evidence-informed framework designed to assess organizational preparedness for responsible AI adoption. SafeAI.report serves as the open-access portal for the framework's digital diagnostics.

scoringEngine.model: quantitatively structured Multi-Criteria Decision Analysis (MCDA) model using role-specific weight allocations.
scoringEngine.validationStatement: Role-specific weights were initially derived through expert judgment and are intended to be empirically refined using continuous institutional validation datasets.

cryptographicIntegrityLayer: a privacy-preserving, tamper-evident cryptographic integrity layer powered by the WaqfLedger Open-Access Consortium Engine.

dimensions.name: Leadership
dimensions.focus: Executive sponsorship, strategic AI direction, and board-level accountability

dimensions.name: Governance
dimensions.focus: Policies, decision rights, and institutional AI control structures

dimensions.name: AI Literacy
dimensions.focus: Human competence under EU AI Act Article 4 (A4-ALAM pillars)
dimensions.scope: Evaluates human competence only; compute cost and tokenization overhead are excluded from this dimension.

a4AlamPillars.title: Structural AI Competency & System Capabilities
a4AlamPillars.competenceFocus: Understanding AI system behaviors, limits, and capability boundaries

a4AlamPillars.title: Risk Recognition & Transparency Mandates
a4AlamPillars.competenceFocus: Identifying deployment risks and fulfilling disclosure obligations

a4AlamPillars.title: Human Oversight & Operational Boundaries
a4AlamPillars.competenceFocus: Intervention authority, escalation, and safe operating envelopes

a4AlamPillars.title: Accountability & Ethical Governance
a4AlamPillars.competenceFocus: Role-linked responsibility, ethical decision frames, and duty of care

dimensions.name: Technology
dimensions.focus: Systems architecture, capability maturity, and integration readiness

dimensions.name: Data Readiness
dimensions.focus: Provenance, quality, lineage, and lawful processing capacity

dimensions.name: Risk & Compliance
dimensions.focus: Statutory alignment, risk classification, and auditability

dimensions.name: Workforce Culture
dimensions.focus: Organizational norms, escalation practice, and continuous learning

dimensions.name: Operational Readiness
dimensions.focus: Runtime capacity, resource allocation, and delivery efficiency

metrics.name: Arabic character tokenization compute-cost overhead
metrics.notes: Modeled exclusively under Dimension 8 (Operational Readiness) as a technical resource-allocation efficiency metric. It is not a literacy competency criterion and must not appear under the AI Literacy / A4-ALAM pillar set.
